Class RmiClient

java.lang.Object
java.rmi.server.RemoteObject
java.rmi.server.RemoteServer
java.rmi.server.UnicastRemoteObject
it.polimi.ingsw.am14.network.rmi.client.RmiClient
All Implemented Interfaces:
VirtualClientRmi, VirtualClient, VirtualServer, Serializable, Remote
public class RmiClient extends UnicastRemoteObject implements VirtualClientRmi, VirtualServer
RMI implementation of the client node. Acts as an intermediary, receiving network calls from the RMI server and dispatching them to the ClientController, while also exposing methods for the client application to forward actions to the remote server.
